::: {#def-rule-of-inference}
#### Rule of inference

A **rule of inference** is a pattern of argument (@def-argument),
written in terms of propositions $P, Q, \ldots$,
whose premises logically entail its conclusion (@def-logical-entailment)
whatever propositions are put in place of $P, Q, \ldots$.
It is written with its premises above a line and its conclusion below:
$$
\frac{P_1, \ldots, P_n}{Q}.
$$

:::
